BiblicalUsage: After the great slaughter the people of Israel burn the weapons of war for fuel for seven years, and the idol-maker burns part of his tree to warm himself before he bows to the rest of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fire tells the truth about what a thing is worth: the weapons of the enemy end as firewood, and the god made of wood ends as fuel for the fire.
